edges.LINKS_TO: Page or Section -> Page, with anchor_text, source_section, target_anchor, and local_context properties

retrieval_policy: Use BM25+HNSW RRF as a non-destructive base. Rank explicit neighbors with query-to-edge-context relevance and seed rank; graph scores can only add a residual boost. Do not use the generic MS MARCO reranker.
change_from_v1: Promote Markdown link text, source section, local sentence context, and target anchor from untyped extraction details into first-class edge properties.
